class.name: JRPGEquipData
class.brief_description: Base class of weapons and armors.
class.description: What weapons and armors have in common: an icon, a description, a price and the parameter changes and traits they give while equipped.

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns the change of parameter [param param] (in [enum JRPGClassData.Param] order).

method.name: get_slot_type_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the equipment slot this equipment goes into.

members.member: Help text shown when the equipment is selected.
Index of the equipment's icon in the project's icon sheet.
Flat parameter changes while equipped, in [enum JRPGClassData.Param] order. Max HP and max MP changes stay within -5000 to 5000, the others within -500 to 500.
Shop price. The equipment sells for half of it; a price of 0 means it cannot be sold.
Traits granted while equipped, as dictionaries with [code]code[/code], [code]data_id[/code] and [code]value[/code].
